subtasks.name: mvplan serve: local web server for the plan
subtasks.description: One command starts a server on 127.0.0.1 that serves the page and a small JSON API over the same store and operations the CLI uses. No new storage, no accounts.

acceptance.text: Binds to localhost only and opens the browser
Reads with buildView and writes through the core operations as the human

subtasks.description: Single page drawn from the view JSON: progress ladder, collapsible tree with who's working where, accept or decline proposals, change priority and status inline. Built with the Frontend Design plugin.

acceptance.text: Every action in the Claude Code panel is also possible here
Change a task's priority or status without leaving the tree

subtasks.description: The page refreshes on its own when agents claim, update or propose, without losing the reader's place.

acceptance.text: A claim made in another session appears within 30 seconds

subtasks.description: Click a task to see its description, acceptance criteria, log, links, dependencies and code markers.

subtasks.description: Starts mvplan serve from the plugin and prints the link, so it's one step from a session.

subtasks.name: Edit the plan's shape from the page
subtasks.description: Add, rename and move tasks in the browser. Until then, structure changes go through agents or the CLI.

log.text: priority Could -> Must; Alex: quick iteration in scoping sessions needs add, rename, move and park from the page
priority Could -> Must; Alex: the human review UI is a key feature

subtasks.name: Live scoping sessions
subtasks.description: Alex and an agent talk through a product idea and the plan changes as they talk: ideas get added, parked as Could or Won't, and re-prioritised in seconds, with the page updating live.

acceptance.text: A 30-minute scoping chat produces a usable plan without anyone typing into the plan directly

subtasks.name: Scoping skill (/mvplanner:scope)
subtasks.description: Tells the agent how to run a scoping session: add tasks straight away with the human's say-so, park side ideas as Could rather than dropping them, ask about priority only when unclear, and read back what changed.

acceptance.text: The agent never writes code during a scoping session

subtasks.name: Batch plan edits in one call
subtasks.description: One tool call applies many adds, moves, renames and priority changes in a single fetch and push, so a burst of ideas lands in about a second instead of one round trip each.

subtasks.name: Move, rename and remove tasks
subtasks.description: Core operations and agent tools to restructure the plan, which scoping needs constantly. The page's editing (T-36) uses the same operations.

subtasks.name: Undo recent plan changes
subtasks.description: Step back the last change or few, using the plan branch's history, for when the conversation changes its mind.

subtasks.name: Turn a meeting transcript into plan changes
subtasks.description: Paste or attach a transcript and the agent proposes the additions and changes for a human to confirm.

subtasks.name: Listen to a live call
subtasks.description: Follow a live meeting's audio or captions rather than a chat. Until then, chat with the agent (voice dictation works) or use transcripts.
